data.fund_type: An open-ended Hybrid Scheme investing predominantly in equity and equity related instruments
data.investment_objective: To provide investors long term capital appreciation along with the liquidity of an open-ended scheme by investing in a mix of debt and equity. The scheme will invest in a diversified portfolio of equities of high growth companies and balance the risk through investing the rest in fixed income securities.
